Class SystemEnvironmentPropertySourceEnvironmentPostProcessor

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.boot.support.SystemEnvironmentPropertySourceEnvironmentPostProcessor
All Implemented Interfaces:
EnvironmentPostProcessor, Ordered
public class SystemEnvironmentPropertySourceEnvironmentPostProcessor extends Object implements EnvironmentPostProcessor, Ordered
一个 `EnvironmentPostProcessor`，它将系统环境`SystemEnvironmentPropertySource`替换为能够跟踪每个系统环境属性的`SystemEnvironmentPropertySourceEnvironmentPostProcessor.OriginAwareSystemEnvironmentPropertySource`，从而记录每个系统环境属性的`SystemEnvironmentOrigin`。
Since:
4.0.0
Author:
Madhura Bhave, Phillip Webb
